text: Select: chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, compound_structures, docs. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, compound_records to docs on doc_id, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1133512', canonical_smiles is not null. Sort: chembl_id ascending, compound_name ascending, canonical_smiles ascending. Deduplication: Return distinct rows for the selected columns.
